# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose vulnerabilities, credentials, or private user data in a
public issue.

Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** flow in this repository's Security tab.
Include the affected endpoint or commit, reproduction steps, expected impact,
and any suggested mitigation. Reports are reviewed privately before public
disclosure.

For non-security bugs and product feedback, use
[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/gj3447/metahumotonic_web_back/issues) or the
feedback form on [metahumotonic.com](https://metahumotonic.com/).
